Trim your clip with:

  • ffmpeg -i "input.mp4" -ss HH:MM:SS -to HH:MM:SS "output.mp4

You can then extract an .mp3 or .wav from the trimmed clip using this:

  • ffmpeg -i "trimmed_video.mp4" -f mp3 -ab 192000 -vn "output.mp3

After that you merge your converted clip with the extracted audio:

  • ffmpeg -i "converted.mp4" -i "extracted.mp3" -c copy "merged_output.mp4
